info.description: The Hotel Loyalty Points Rules API allows developers to access and manage the rules governing loyalty points accumulation and redemption for hotel programs. This API provides detailed information regarding the criteria and conditions under which guests earn points, enhancing customer engagement and loyalty. Use cases include integrating loyalty functionalities into booking systems or user apps, enabling customers to view current earning rules. The API serves hotel chains and travel agencies looking to optimize their loyalty programs and improve customer satisfaction.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the current points rules, which define how points are earned and redeemed within the application. Make sure to review them for understanding rewards mechanics.
